text: Cute floating island, a white bunny next to a tomato bed. Prompt says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Odd that it says Day 2 already. Tapping the tomatoes.
Sowed, watered - crops growing. Day/night cycle is fast (30 sec days). Now it wants me to tap a Momo - the bunny is a Momo I guess. There's also a faint ring at the bottom left, maybe a joystick?

Assigned the Momo to the farm tile (1/4 tiles). Island seems to be 4 tiles: farm, an empty one highlighted on the left, tree, flowers. Message says empty tiles can build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab. The text box covers the tile picker a bit. Tapping Got it.
Momo now farms on its own, coins ticking up (+$20/min). Farm skill went up to 1. There is a mail bubble and a red dot on Mailbox - opening mail.
A sweet letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Love the airmail letter look. Tapping Let's research it.

Research tree! Tabs: Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games... Field expansion needs 0/3 flasks + $20, and the button says 'Build a research lab'. So I need a lab first. Let's tap that button and see if it guides me.
Build menu on the empty tile: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. I'm at 75/90 XP so Lv2 is close. Curious what Special is.
Hit Lv2. Research lab now $40, Lumberyard $80. Building the lab on the left empty tile so I can do Momo's proposals.
Lab built - cute blue roof with a flask sign. The bottom shows Experiment 5s left, seems to run by itself? Waiting to see if flasks appear.
Experiment finished and Research got a red dot - I think I earned a flask. Tapping Experiment again to collect more flasks for Field expansion (need 3).
5 flasks now, Lv3. Starting Field expansion research. I notice the bunny walked over to the lab (Research lab 1/1) - did it leave the farm? The tomatoes are ripe and waiting.
Research running (30s). Opened Hire - a second Momo costs $60, I have 130. Hiring one so one can farm and one can run the lab.
Field expansion Lv1 done (crops +1). It can go to Lv5. Watering efficiency (Momo's second idea) is now unlocked - picking that instead.
Income doubled - harvests now give +$8, $80/min. Mochi is working the lab. Watering efficiency research started. Third letter waiting.

Bottom tile is buildable too. Mine needs $120 + 10 wood (wood shown in red, I have none), so a Lumberyard comes first. Building a cheap second farm here ($10), then I'll try the tree tile for a lumberyard.
Ooh - the sea next to the island can be bought for $25 to expand! The tree tile also opened a build menu. Building a Lumberyard there ($80) for wood.
Bought the sea tile - the island grew a new grassy tile with a tree and flowering bush. That felt great. $136/min now. Now building a lumberyard on the old tree tile.
Lumberyard is up (stump, axe, logs, saplings - lovely). Both bunnies seem to be at the farms though, even Mochi whom I put on the lab? Hiring a 3rd Momo ($100) for the lumberyard.
Pomu assigned to the lumberyard. The status line says 'next crop is ripening' even for a lumberyard - a bit confusing. Research has a red dot, checking it.
Watering efficiency done. Starting Bigger harvests (Momo's 3rd letter idea) - nice that the letters line up with the tree. Then I'll peek at the Games tab, curious what that is.
Games tab: 'Software - an island game studio' at Player Lv6. Ha, a game studio on a bunny island. New mail again - opening.
Pomu writes too now - Tree nursery proposal. Reached Lv4 (next needs 1200 XP, big jump). Accepting, then buying the $35 sea tile to grow the island.
Oops - the Momo panel was covering the $35 sea tile price tag, so my tap hit Pomu's Assign button instead. Trying to close the panel by tapping the sky.
Bought the second sea tile, island is now an L/square shape and runs off the right edge of the screen. Trying to build a Mine on the new tile if I have 10 wood.
Mine under construction ($120 + 10 wood). Next sea tile is $45 - prices climb each time. Going to hire a 4th Momo for the mine.
Mugi assigned to the mine (the 1 marker is half hidden under the panel). Confirming. With about a minute left I'll check the Status screen to see what it shows.

Status screen shows the island is called Momonium, a Village. Clear goal to Become a City: Land 6/9, Momo 4/3 done, Research levels 2/3, value produced 1K/1.5K. Finally a clear target! Going to buy more land.
Land bought (7/9 now), Bigger harvests finished - $270/min. Quickly checking the Lumber research tab for Pomu's Tree nursery idea.

Tree nursery is locked behind Sharp axes, so starting Sharp axes. That would get research levels to 3/3 for the City goal. Another letter just arrived. Out of time soon - I'd definitely keep going toward City.
Mugi the miner wrote 'Green streaks in the rock' - copper? Each worker writes their own ideas, I love that. $336/min, 460 coins.
